description:
A billing audit revealed a missing charge for patient Maria Santos. You need to update her existing draft invoice #INV-2024-001.

1. Navigate to the Billing / Invoices section.
2. Open the draft invoice #INV-2024-001 for Maria Santos.
3. Add a new line item for 'Urinalysis' (Price: $25.00) with a quantity of 1.
4. Save the invoice.

The 'Urinalysis' item is already in the pricing catalog.
